changelog: csearch_ranked_ids keeps a product id, and reads the limit, given as a string of digits, as $wpdb->get_col() returns ids: a caller passing such ids got an empty answer with no warning, and a string limit was ignored. A string with a sign, a decimal point, an exponent or a space, and any other type, is still ignored; the 2,000-id and 1-to-500 bounds are unchanged, and "42" and 42 count as one id (D-164).
